title: Da Beach Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutDa Beach ~ 163 Gulf Shore Drive ~ Grayton Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. Celebrate USA250 in style this Summer at Da Beach– a new construction, luxury beachfront home with private dune walkover in the gated Gulf Trace community, with beach chair setups (4 chairs + 2 umbrellas) for each full day of your stay. Da Beach is now featuring a 10% introductory savings for Summer 2026. Book today for the best Summer yet! Discount reflected in online pricing and applies to new bookings only for Summer 2026 stays. Welcome to Da Beach, a brand new, Gulf-front oasis nestled in the highly sought-after Gulf Trace neighborhood. This exquisite 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath retreat comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests and offers 5,328 sq. ft. of luxurious living space (3,727 sq. ft. interior, 1,601 sq. ft. exterior), with the convenience of an elevator servicing all three floors. Featuring three expansively covered porches with breathtaking Gulf views, plus a hot tub on the bottom deck for ultimate relaxation, this home provides a perfect setting for unwinding and enjoying the coastal beauty. Step onto the private beach walkover to enjoy the famous white sugar sand beaches of the Emerald Coast. Being surrounded by the Grayton Beach State Park gives guests ONE FULL MILE of beautiful, undisturbed beaches to enjoy. Da Beach is the ideal escape for large families or groups seeking a secluded, high-end beach getaway. Please NOTE: Golf carts and on-street parking are Strictly Prohibited in the Gulf Trace neighborhood, per neighborhood covenants. Daily beach service set-up (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) is included with your rental! Garage is not accessible for guest vehicles. Da Beach borders the Grayton Beach State Park, named America’s #1 Beach in 2020 by Dr. Stephen Leatherman, aka Dr. Beach! “This beach boasts of its sugar-white sand and emerald, green water where development has been restrained so big sand dunes still dominate the landscape. At the same time, all the amenities of great restaurants and accommodations are close by in the old town of Grayton Beach or Seaside," wrote Leatherman. Originally named the country’s top beach in 1994, Grayton Beach State Park has been listed FOUR times since 1991, finishing 6th in 2016 and 3rd in 2019. First Level: Guest entrance through garage. Foyer. Elevator servicing all 3 floors. Powder room. Wet bar. Bar seating for 4 inside. Bar seating for 4 outside. Deck seating for 4 facing gulf. Hot tub. Private beach walkover. Second Level: Living Room (fireplace decorative only). Fully equipped kitchen. Dining table seats 6. Bar seating for 5. Butler Pantry. 2 bedrooms. 2 full baths. Gulf front deck. Grill. Deck seating for 6. Additional seating for 8. #1 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower, doors leading to covered deck, pack-n-play in closet (guests to provide bedding). #2 Bunk Bedroom has built-in Full-over-Queen bunk.Full hallway bath with tub/shower. Third Level: 3 bedrooms. 3 full baths. Laundry room. Gulf front covered porch. Porch seating for 2. #3 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, Gulf front covered porch, separate vanities, walk-in shower.#4 En-Suite Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in-shower. #5 En-Site Bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower. Amenities: Business Features Hi Speed Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 8 Smart Tv’s (streaming services available with guest personal login credentials) Distinctive Features Luxurious new construction with high-end finishes Gulf front with expansive Gulf views Elevator servicing all 3 floors Daily beach service included (4 chairs, 2 umbrellas) Hot Tub Pack-n-play (located in #1 Bedroom closet; guests to provide bedding) Bed, bath, and kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Driveway parking for 4 vehicles (garage not accessible for guest vehicles) 4 King beds, 1 Full-over-queen bunk bed Pack-n-Play (no bedding provided; guests will need to bring) 5 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, iron, ironing board, 5 hair dryers, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, three outdoor covered porches facing the Gulf, porch furniture. Linens & bath towels provided. No Smoking. No Pets. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, custom cabinetry, island with seating for 5, farmhouse sink, Café French door fridge with ice dispenser, Bosch double wall oven, Bosch electric oven with glass top, stainless dishwasher, Butler’s pantry with prep sink, under counter beverage cooler, under counter wine cooler, drip coffee maker, Keurig, toaster oven, blender, washer and dryer. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) “Downtown” Grayton (1.5 miles) Seaside (2 miles) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
